contracts.source: Applied Materials press release: Applied Materials and KIOXIA Partner at the EPIC Center to (09-29-2026)
contracts.signal: KIOXIA will join Applied's EPIC Center in Silicon Valley as an innovation partner; the companies will collaborate on R&D in advanced memory cell and structure creation for higher-density memory architectures, multi-chip stacking for next-generation memory, advanced packaging for stacked memory, and materials engineering that supports manufacturability at scale, to increase memory density and performance for AI. KIOXIA's Minori Kajimoto: the companies aim to accelerate the commercialization of breakthroughs in memory and packaging technologies. Applied says the EPIC Center will be operationally ready this year, with capital spending expected to scale over time to approximately $5 billion as customer projects commence.
